ipos.hq: South San Francisco, CA · Dublin, IE
ipos.summary: Payments infrastructure for the internet. Processes ~$1T in TPV across 50+ countries. Profitable on a cash basis since 2023; tender offer at $91.5B in Feb 2024 hinted at IPO timing. Direct competitor: Adyen.
risks: Valuation reset risk vs Adyen multiple compression
Take-rate pressure from large enterprise customers
Crypto / stablecoin regulatory drag post-Bridge acquisition

ipos.summary: Lakehouse data platform with ~$3B ARR. Closed $10B Series J in Dec 2024 at $62B; bankers retained for an IPO window in late 2026 per WSJ reporting.
highlights: Acquired MosaicML for $1.3B in 2023 (open-source LLM training)
risks: Snowflake price-pressure on storage/compute pricing
AI training capex cycle could compress margins
Late-cycle valuation: priced for perfect execution

ipos.summary: Buy-now-pay-later pioneer turned full-service neobank. F-1 filed publicly in Nov 2024, return to profitability in 2024 after 2022 markdown from $46B to $6.7B.
highlights: Returned to profitability Q1 2024 after AI-driven cost cuts
risks: Credit-loss exposure if European consumer weakens
Affirm + Apple Pay Later competitive squeeze
Regulatory: EU/UK BNPL rules tightening 2026

ipos.summary: Ultra-fast-fashion marketplace; switched from US to UK listing in 2024 after FBI / SEC scrutiny. ~$45B in 2024 GMV per analyst estimates.
highlights: Pivoted from NYC to London listing path mid-2024
risks: De minimis import-duty closure (US tariff overhang)
Forced-labor / supply-chain audit findings
China-listing geopolitical risk

ipos.summary: Real-time community platform with 200M+ MAU. Hired new CFO 2024, retained Goldman in early 2025 — IPO speculation has been steady through 2026.
highlights: 200M+ monthly active users; 19M weekly active servers
Subscription Nitro reaching $700M ARR per leak
risks: Monetization vs free-tier loyalty tension
Content-moderation liability (CSAM, extremism flares)
Has been publicly profitable for one quarter (Q4-23) only

ipos.summary: US neobank focused on lower-income earners; S-1 filed Nov 2024, $1.7B Q3 2024 revenue, ~7M+ active accounts.
risks: Interchange-fee regulation (Durbin amendments) downside
Last private valuation $25B may reset 30-50% lower
Concentration in cash-strapped consumer segment

ipos.summary: SpaceX itself remains private at $350B; persistent Musk comments suggest spinning out Starlink (LEO satellite broadband) once cash flow stabilises. Speculative timing.
highlights: SpaceX overall valuation $350B in Dec 2024 tender
risks: Highly Musk-dependent governance
Frequency / spectrum disputes (FCC, EU)
Spinout timing entirely at controlling-shareholder discretion

ipos.summary: Web-based design platform with 200M+ monthly users and ~$3B ARR. Profitable; CFO hired 2023, secondary tenders Oct 2024 at $32B.
risks: Adobe / Figma price competition
AI tools commoditizing some workflows
Australia-domiciled — currency / listing-venue overhang

ipos.summary: Issuer of USDC ($60B+ in circulation as of 2026). Refiled S-1 in Jan 2025 after first attempt withdrawn 2022. Revenue largely from yield on T-bill reserves.
risks: 100% of revenue tied to short-rate yield on reserves
Stablecoin regulatory framework still in flux (US GENIUS Act draft)
Tether dominance + Coinbase USDC revenue share

ipos.summary: AI chip startup making wafer-scale processors as a NVIDIA H100 alternative. S-1 filed 2024 with $136M H1 revenue, but customer concentration (G42) flagged repeatedly.
risks: G42 = 87% of H1 2024 revenue (single-customer risk)
CFIUS scrutiny of UAE customer relationship
NVIDIA / AMD / Groq competitive pressure
